name: Sycamore Adventure Playground
description: A staffed, fully accessible adventure playground on the Old Park Farm estate, with water play, sand play, trampolines, a cycle path and woodland. Public sessions run through the week for different ages; check the session times and booking before visiting. There's a suggested donation of £2.50 per child in term time and £4 in school holidays and at events.
